message:
I remember a time when my grandkids showed up for a weekend visit and we had a little impromptu picnic in the backyard. I went to grab some snacks and realized I had no napkins or even a blanket for us to sit on. We made do with some old towels, and you know, it turned into a laugh fest as we tried to keep crumbs off ourselves. 

It struck me then how being prepared could turn potential chaos into smooth sailing. I’ve found that having a little plan in place for unexpected moments can save you from the comedy of not being ready. 

So, if you’re ever in the mood to think ahead, it might be worth checking out some resources that help you get your home ready for anything. After all, a little prep can make all the difference! What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared?
